summary: Tested the new ChatGPT (openai/gpt-5.4 via emergentintegrations) AI integration end-to-end: backend pytest (15/15 passed with real LLM streaming) + frontend Playwright flows for assistant page, smart search in catalog, admin product description generator, and admin chat reply draft. All four AI features work and all auth / validation / rate-limit edge cases behave as specified. Regression on /api/parts-finder/config passed too.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/ai.py uses created_at stored as ISO string; counting with {'$gte': iso_string} works lexicographically because ISO-8601 with timezone is sortable, OK.
The `in_stock` field added to smart-search products mutates the dict returned straight to the client; harmless but worth noting (no `_id` / `purchase_price` leak confirmed by tests).
Assistant streaming writes the user message to Mongo BEFORE the LLM call succeeds — if the LLM errors the user message will persist without an assistant reply. Minor UX nit, not a blocker.
seed_data_creation: Rate-limit test inserts 60 ai_usage docs with marker TEST_RL_<hex> for the test user and deletes them in the same test. Assistant streaming test creates ai_chat_messages for random session_ids and the test_zz_cleanup_sessions test deletes them.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI backend routes are at /app/backend/routes/ai.py and mounted via routes/__init__.py. Login endpoint returns {token, user} (field is `token`, NOT access_token). MONGO_URL/DB_NAME in /app/backend/.env are quoted — use dotenv to load. Admin product edit button testid is `edit-<product_id>` and opens the modal containing `ai-generate-description-btn` and `product-description-input`. Admin chat list items are plain text buttons (click by user name). Assistant streaming SSE events: products -> delta* -> done. Real LLM call latency ~1-5s in testing. All 4 AI features verified passing on iteration 107.
